description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes, representing tree width, and Accuracy@1 percentage for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 7, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 35, and tick labels at intervals of 5. The GPT-4o line is dark blue, solid, and marked with circles, starting at 24.4% accuracy with 1 child node, increasing to 28.9% with 3 child nodes, peaking at 34.4% with 5 child nodes, and then decreasing to 31.1% with 7 child nodes. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line is light blue, solid, and marked with crosses, beginning at 26.7% accuracy with 1 child node, rising slightly to 27.8% with 3 child nodes, then declining to 24.4% with 5 child nodes, and further decreasing to 20.0% with 7 child nodes.
